headline: SEA @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.55 at HOU 3.76, with a projected total of 8.31. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: SEA moved -0.80 runs while HOU moved -0.52, changing the projected margin by -0.28 runs. The projected total fell -1.32, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +14.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Peter Lambert has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.5 ER over the last 4 starts. Batter research is strongest for Julio Rodríguez, Josh Naylor, Isaac Paredes, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Cal Raleigh, Leo Rivas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
